preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain ownership through nomination/acceptance)
Victim address must hold some BabyApe tokens

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the burn() function with any victim address and amount to destroy their tokens without permission. This reduces total supply and could increase the relative value of remaining tokens (including owner's tokens). For maximum economic impact, burn tokens from large holders to manipulate token scarcity.
